title: Five Nights at Freddy's Additions
description: Adds Stylized FNAF to your world
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e2c8ec0c876087ae8265b192b1538136152e1ca.png)

                 **   Welcome to Five Nights at Freddys Additions!**

Five Nights at Freddy's additions aims to seperate itself from other Five Nights at Freddy's mods by redesigning the Animatronics and giving them some unique properties, and by adding some of the stranger parts of the FNAF-o-verse.



This Mod so far adds content ranging from FNAF 1-3 with some other games sprinkled in the mix with plans to eventually cover the rest of the games and some fan-games.



Features

Functional Freddy Mask
Withered Foxy AI
Over 200+ blocks
29 Animatronics (More to come)
Completely Survival Friendly
AND SO MUCH MORE!!

Created by - Aysome



Five Nights at Freddy's is created by Scott Cawthon
